relations_to.summary: Cypriot officials said the March 2026 drones were launched from Lebanon and blamed Hezbollah; Iranian IRGC responsibility is also possible and no party claimed the attacks. Greek F-16s intercepted two drones in Lebanese airspace heading for Cyprus.
relations_to.note: Attribution is contested: Christodoulides first described the drone as Iranian; the foreign minister told The Guardian it came from Lebanon.

sources.title: Cypriot, Lebanese officials blame Hezbollah for drone attacks on UK base in Cyprus; IRGC responsibility also possible
British air base in Cyprus hit by suspected drone strike
